name: STC-108XGDGP.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial PoE Switch/STC-108XGDGP.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts high-quality and high-speed network intelligent chip and completely solves the noise problem of small switches in the office environment through the fan-less mute design
This switch has 8*100/1000/2500M PoE ports and 1*10G SFP port enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M/2.5G Ethernet
easy to manage and maintain
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
8*100/1000/2500M PoE Port+1*10G SFP Port
Support 802.3, IEEE802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab,  IEEE 802.3bz,  IEEE 802.3ae,  IEEE 802.3x standard
Ethernet Ports support 100/1000/2500M self- adaptive
Support PoE QoS Priority，priority ranges from 1 to 8. Enabled by default
Supports automatic port flipping(Auto MDI/MDIX)
Panel indicator monitoring status and help failure analysis
Flow control mode: IEEE 802.3X standard for full duplex, and Back Pressure standard for half duplex
Surge Protection: General 4KV, Differential 2KV(level B), ESD 12KV air, 6KV contact(level C)
Specification
Product Name	9 Port Hybrid Rate Ethernet PoE Switch
Port	8*100/1000/2500M PoE port(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing) / 1*10G SFP Port
Switching Capacity	60Gbps
Throughput	44.64Mpps
MAC Address	4K
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network protocol	IEEE802.3 (Ethernet) / IEEE802.3u (Fast Ethernet) / IEEE802.3ab (Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3bz (5G Ethernet） / IEEE 802.3z (Gigabit Ethernet） / IEEE 802.3ae (10G Gigabit Ethernet） / IEEE802.3x (Flow Control)
PoE Protocol	IEEE802.3af(15.4W) / IEEE802.3at(30W)
PoE Wiring	1/2(+), 3/6(-)
PoE Output Voltage	DC44-57V
PoE Budget	100W
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15, CISPR (EN55032) class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2 (ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3,4,5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Optical Medium	multi mode: 50/125, 62.5/125, 100/140um / Single mode: 8/125, 8.7/125, 9/125, 10/125um
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Power	Power Input Voltage: AC100-240V
Internal AC-DC Converter: 52V1.92A
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / 1-8 Port green light / On: 2.5G Link connect normal / Off: Link off / Flashing: data transmitting / 1-8 Port yellow light / On: 10/100/1000M Link connect normal / Off: Link off / Flashing: data transmitting / 9 Port green light/Blue Light / Blue on:10G link / Green on: 1000/2500M link / Off: Link blocked / Flashing: Data transmitting / 1-8 PoE Light / On:PoE is working / Off:PoE is not working / PoE Max Power Light / On: indicates that PoE power is used at 95%<P<100% / Flashing: indicates PoE power usage of 90% ≤ P ≤ 95% / Off: indicates PoE power usage is less than 90%
Dimension
Remark
Please contact us if the source file is needed
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 220*161*44mm
Inner box size: 315*215*85mm
Product weight: 0.91Kg
Packing weight: 1.23Kg
Master box size: 445*445*335mm
Packing quantity: 10Pcs
Packing weight: 13.3Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power adapter is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
